channel.title: Haps Club: newsletter archive
channel.description: Hand-picked things to do in Los Angeles, one free email every Tuesday.

item.title: Jazz, all week
item.description: Big bands in Bel Air, two jazzy tree lightings, holiday swing at BroadStage, and our 1926 party.

item.title: Party like it’s 1926
item.description: A 1926 party, an all-you-can-eat Italian holiday night, a salsa night, and more.

item.title: Costumes, candlelight, and one last seat
item.description: Halloween in WeHo, a jazz costume party, Noche de los Muertos, a new pasta bar on Main Street, and the last call for our supper club.

item.title: Close out the year with an intimate dinner and a Jazz Age party
item.description: A candlelit dinner, a 1926 jazz club, and 10% off with HAPSCLUBPLUS.

item.title: Dinner, jazz, and all of Halloween
item.description: Dinner, jazz, a month of Halloween, and one last free Saturday on the Santa Monica Pier.

item.title: Supper Club, and a Month of Halloween
item.description: Our Underground Supper Club returns November 1, plus a month of Halloween, CicLAvia on Sunday, and a free late night at the Hammer.

item.title: Open Streets, Late Art
item.description: CicLAvia opens downtown streets Sunday, ArtNight lights up Pasadena Friday, and the Westside gets a free late night at the Hammer.

item.title: Back for Seconds
item.description: Back to Hermanito Broadway for dinner Thursday, the Lucas Museum is finally open, and the Westside is loaded this weekend with Pier Play and First Friday.

item.title: Dinner at Hermanito
item.description: An intimate dinner at Hermanito Broadway, Thursday October 1. Early bird pricing won't last.

item.title: Let's All Hang Out
item.description: The Summer Social is Wednesday in Santa Monica, there is a free Toastmasters session next Tuesday, and the next BizColab cohort has two seats open.

item.title: Four Seats Left
item.description: Four seats are left at Saturday's long table, Sophocles runs in Nahuatl at the Getty Villa, and Saturday night makes you choose between a brass band and a rooftop Truman Show.

item.title: Tap Dance on Pointe
item.description: The LA Phil and LA Ballet share a stage for the first time tonight, plus a Thursday triple-header and a new bodega in Venice.

item.title: The Long Weekend
item.description: Labor Day gives us one last three-day run at summer — John Williams at the Bowl, movies at Hollywood Forever, and a new raw bar by the pier.

item.title: Tonight at Sunset
item.description: Join us this evening, oceanfront in Santa Monica. Dollar tacos tomorrow.

item.title: Summer Time Fun All Week
item.description: Our sunset happy hour, free desks by the beach, the Foo Fighters with the LA Phil, and BizColab's second cohort.

item.title: Let’s Stay Together
item.description: Al Green under the stars, two weeks of prix fixe, a slumber party at the cemetery, and s’mores on the sand.

item.title: One Friday, Two Nights
item.description: Cocktails on the sand at five, eighteen miles on foot at eleven, a friend’s film about Girl Scouts, and seventeen days of jazz across LA.

item.title: The Sound of August
item.description: Free gospel-soul in a hillside courtyard, jazz on the LACMA plaza, a block party at the end of Washington Blvd, and a night swim in a 1920s pool.

item.title: After the Long Table
item.description: A great dinner behind us, and a full week ahead: a live taping in Venice, mariscos and movies on the sand, a LACMA weekend to circle, and two September dates to lock in now.

item.title: Save the Dates
item.description: The final seats at Saturday's table, and the August nights to lock in now.

item.title: Free in the Plaza
item.description: A week of free nights downtown, and one slow day west of Lincoln.

item.title: Downtown Nights, Westside Days
item.description: Free music in the plaza, a classic in the cemetery, and a slow day west of Lincoln.

item.title: Red, White & the Long Weekend
item.description: A day early for the Fourth — our Hermanito dinner Thursday, LA's best block parties and fireworks, and a few west-of-Lincoln ideas.

item.title: The Garden Glowed
item.description: Nearly 100 of you packed the garden for our Summer Solstice party — plus our next dinner at Hermanito Broadway, July 2.

item.title: The Longest Day
item.description: Our open-air solstice party in West Adams lands Saturday — and the whole city is dressing up for it.

item.title: The Garden Party
item.description: The longest evening of the year, and five more reasons to leave the house.

item.title: Week of June 3
item.description: June is here, and LA has no plans to slow down.

item.title: The Back Nine
item.description: A special edition for the back half of the long weekend.

item.title: The Long Weekend
item.description: Sunset salsa, jazz on the lawn, and the MDW shortlist.

item.title: Date Night LA
item.description: The week's best places to meet, eat, and linger.
